design.decision: The whole hand is stronger before bidding, so bid it up.
design.opponent: Hidden until a raised card wins a trick it otherwise wouldn't.
design.rationale: seed-raise (rare, two ranks) is the best-measured enabler in the registry (+12.4). One rank at common gives commons a strong, simple, build-agnostic enabler, as the brief asks. Deliberate near-duplicate on amount.
design.draftText: Opening: Raise every card your team holds by one rank

history.note: draft-common: merged into ca-raise-one, an identical design from another cluster.
